    Purchase options and add-ons

    The gift for the dad-to-be: a 9-month fatherhood roadmap for first-time dads, and a thoughtful gift for a baby shower, a pregnancy announcement, or Christmas.

    Shopping for a new dad or     expecting dad for Christmas? You probably know exactly how he feels.

    Most pregnancy books are written for moms, which leaves dads-to-be on the sidelines.

    You Will Rock As A Dad! The Expecting Father Guide gives first-time fathers a practical path through pregnancy, birth preparation, and early fatherhood, with real-world advice, humor, and strategies designed specifically for men.

    It's a gift he'll actually read, and it helps him feel ready instead of overwhelmed.

    This is not another pregnancy book. It's the First-Time Fatherhood Blueprint.

    A GREAT GIFT FOR:
    - A husband or partner who just said "we're pregnant"
    - A pregnancy announcement or baby reveal gift
    - A baby shower, new parents gift, or Christmas stocking stuffer for a dad-to-be
    - A son, son-in-law, brother, or friend becoming a father for the first time

    INSIDE THIS BOOK, HE'LL DISCOVER:


    Are you excited about becoming a father but secretly wondering if you are actually ready for everything that's about to change?

    • The Expecting Dad Preparation Plan: What happens throughout pregnancy, and how to be a supportive teammate before your baby arrives.

    • The Pregnancy Support Playbook: Practical ways to help with pregnancy symptoms, appointments, birth planning, and the emotional changes your partner experiences.

    • The Fatherhood Confidence Framework: The common fears new dads face, and how to replace uncertainty with the knowledge to step into your role with confidence.

    • The Birth Day Blueprint: How to prepare for labor, hospital visits, and delivery day decisions.

    • The Relationship Protection System: How to stay connected to your partner through postpartum challenges and beyond.

    • The New Dad Essentials Guide: The supplies, routines, and practical skills that help you feel ready to care for your newborn.


    IF YOU'RE THE DAD-TO-BE, THIS BOOK IS FOR YOU IF:
    - You just heard the words "we're pregnant" and want to be the best partner and father possible.
    - You feel excited about your baby but overwhelmed by everything you don't know yet.
    - You want to support your partner instead of watching the pregnancy from the sidelines.
    - You want honest, practical advice that doesn't make fatherhood feel intimidating.

    Fatherhood does not begin when your baby arrives. It begins with every decision, every conversation, and every moment you choose to show up during pregnancy.

    Your partner does not need a perfect dad. Your baby does not need a perfect dad. They need someone who is willing to learn, support, and grow into the role.

    Giving a gift to both new parents? Pair it with You Will Rock As a Mom!, or get both together in the You Will Rock As a Dad! and You Will Rock As a Mom! Collection.

    Give the dad-to-be on your list the confidence to rock fatherhood.

    You Will Rock As a Dad!: The Expert Guide to First-Time Pregnancy and Everything New Fathers Need to Know

    Editorial Reviews

    Review

    Alex Grace's passion for fatherhood led him to write his debut book "You Will Rock As A Dad: The Expert Guide to First-time Pregnancy and Everything New Fathers Need to Know".

    "You Will Rock as a Dad" is written in an engaging and approachable style, making it easy for new fathers to read and understand. Grace's lighthearted tonality and on-the-nose "dad jokes" make the book feel relatable and authentic for first-time fathers.

    Overall, Alex Grace's passion for fatherhood and desire to help others have made "You Will Rock As A Dad" an invaluable resource for new fathers. His dedication to his work and love for fatherhood shine through in his writing, making it a must-read for any new dad.
    - The Portland Observer

    You Will Rock As A Dad is our favorite survival guide for expectant fathers. This book covers everything soon-to-be fathers need to know about, from pregnancy, to birth and beyond. You Will Rock As a Dad focuses on the changes your partner is going through so you can be a supportive partner and offer the help they really need.
    - WonderBaby

    One of the reasons we consider this one of the best books for expecting dads is the focus on a healthy relationship. Alex Grace includes lots of tips to maintain a happy relationship through pregnancy and beyond. You will be your partner's main support through pregnancy, birth and parenthood, and this book will ensure you do a good job.
    - WonderBaby

    1. Follow

      Alex Grace

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Alex Grace is a DADpreneur from Portland, Oregon. He comes from a sports family where days and evenings were spent throwing the ball around with his four other siblings. Being in childcare, Grace has many years of experience engaging with kids from different backgrounds. Becoming an author was something Alex had always wanted to venture into. When he had his first child, he saw an opportunity to bundle his love for teamwork, children, and becoming a dad into one! Alex has sold over 200,000 copies of his "You Will Rock As a Dad! books since launching in 2022. Now a best-selling author for his 2 debut books and featured in multiple media outlets, Alex continues to write for first-time fathers.

      See more on the author's page
    2. Follow

      You Will Rock Books

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      You Will Rock Books publishes confidence-building parenting books and meaningful keepsake journals for moms, dads, and families.

      Best known for bestselling titles that support first-time fathers, pregnancy, and early parenthood, You Will Rock Books blends practical advice, real-world parenting guidance, and relatable humor to help parents feel prepared and supported during life’s biggest transitions.

      Beyond parenting guides, the You Will Rock Books collection includes beautifully crafted keepsake journals designed to help families capture memories, express love, and preserve meaningful moments - making them perfect gifts for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, baby showers, and milestone occasions.

      Each book is created to be both useful and emotional: offering clear guidance when it’s needed most, while also encouraging reflection, connection, and confidence.

      With multiple #1 bestselling books and over 200,000 copies sold worldwide, You Will Rock Books is trusted by families looking for practical support, thoughtful gifts, and books they’ll return to for years to come.
